machine_path.format: JavaScript array dumps served from S3/CloudFront static site

update_cadence.publisher_claim: Portal shows ongoing refresh; dataJs Last-Modified advanced on observation morning (UTC).
update_cadence.product_rule: Daily worker scheduled ingest rebuilds D1 passport_contracts and passport_rfx from dataJs dumps.

terms.portal_owner: NYC Mayor's Office of Contract Services (MOCS)
terms.notes: Public portal; no API key. Static dumps are intended for the portal DataTables UI and are reused as the stable machine path in lieu of a Socrata dataset.

join_measurement.strategy: exact | pin_strip_suffix | pin_prefix_of_epin | epin_prefix_of_pin (EPIN length >= 10; remainder digits or letter+2-4 digits). Weak shared-prefix joins rejected.
